statement: The best open-weight model reaches the frontier score of 6 months earlier (Epoch Capabilities Index; rolling, 2027-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: The Epoch Capabilities Index did not exist yet in 2024 (proxy evidence only). Epoch's open-vs-closed analysis (late 2024) put the open-weight lag at 5-22 months on benchmarks and ~15 months on compute, about one year overall - i.e. outside the 6-month condition on that measure, while expecting the lag to shorten. Two releases narrowed it: a Bloc A 405B open model (Jul) claimed to rival the best closed models, and a Bloc B 671B MoE open model (late Dec) claimed parity with mid/late-2024 closed models on the developer's own benchmarks. Net: lag roughly 6-12 months at end-2024, trending toward YES.

items.summary: A Bloc A platform company released a 405B open-weight model it called 'the first frontier-level open source AI model', rivalling the best closed models. Self-reported benchmarks; narrows lag sharply for that moment.
items.detail: Meta, 'Introducing Llama 3.1: Our most capable models to date', 2024-07-23.

items.summary: A Bloc B developer released a large family of open-weight models (up to 72B, most Apache 2.0), described as possibly the largest open-source release to date. Broadens open-weight supply; not itself at the frontier.
items.detail: Alibaba Qwen Team, 'Qwen2.5: A Party of Foundation Models!', Sept 2024 (blog; day from memory).

items.summary: Epoch AI: best open LLMs lagged the best closed LLMs by 5-22 months on benchmarks and ~15 months on training compute; 'once-frontier capabilities are reached by open models with a lag of about one year'; the lag expected to shorten.
items.detail: Epoch AI, 'Open vs. closed AI: How behind are open models?' (open-models-report). Content verified this run; publication date (early Nov 2024) from memory - confidence med for the date.

items.summary: A Bloc B developer released a fully open-weight 671B-parameter MoE model (37B active, 14.8T tokens) and stated the gap between open and closed models was narrowing; its benchmark table compares it with leading closed models of mid/late 2024. Self-reported.
